topicTitle: Rates of Change and Behavior of Graphs
description: Reasoning vault aligned with OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e §3.3: average rate of change from formulas, tables, and graphs; interpreting its sign and units; describing intervals of increase, decrease, and constancy; and locating local extrema.

archetypes.name: Compute Average Rate of Change
archetypes.source: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e §3.3 — Finding the Average Rate of Change of a Function
archetypes.coreConcept: Average rate of change compares the net change in output to the net change in input over an interval. It is a secant slope, with units of output per input.
archetypes.mentalModel: Compare the two endpoint outputs and divide their change by the matching endpoint input change; preserve the same endpoint order in numerator and denominator.

cognitiveTraps.description: Reversing the order of the input difference while keeping the output difference order, changing the sign.
Reporting the total output change without dividing by the input change.

archetypes.figureNone: For a numeric average rate calculation, the endpoint values and interval fully determine the secant slope; a graph is not needed to compute it.

archetypes.name: Read Increasing, Decreasing, and Constant Intervals
archetypes.source: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e §3.3 — Using a Graph to Determine Where a Function is Increasing, Decreasing, or Constant
archetypes.coreConcept: A function is increasing, decreasing, or constant on intervals according to how its output changes as the input moves from left to right.
archetypes.mentalModel: Scan the graph from left to right: rising means increasing, falling means decreasing, and a horizontal segment means constant.
archetypes.governingRelation: \Delta x>0; \operatorname{sign}(\Delta f) \text{ determines the average trend}

cognitiveTraps.description: Describing graph behavior while scanning from right to left instead of as input increases.
cognitiveTraps.trapFormula: x \text{ decreases while reading the curve}

cognitiveTraps.description: Confusing the input location of a local extremum with its output value.
Treating the entire displayed graph window as monotone without checking whether the curve turns inside it.

archetypes.name: Derive Average Rate of Change as an Expression
archetypes.source: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e §3.3 — Computing Average Rate of Change for a Function Expressed as a Formula
archetypes.coreConcept: Substituting symbolic interval endpoints into the average-rate quotient can reveal a simplified expression that describes the change across a family of intervals.
archetypes.mentalModel: Evaluate the function at both endpoints first, then simplify the difference quotient while tracking restrictions on any cancelled factor.

cognitiveTraps.description: Cancelling terms across addition or subtraction instead of cancelling common factors.
Reversing the order of the input difference while keeping the output difference order, changing the sign.

archetypes.figureNone: This archetype targets symbolic simplification of a difference quotient; a graph would not add information to the algebraic task.
